items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: That's the same guy who used to work with Dewey Jackson?

ctx.x: I picked it up myself. I picked it up myself. I picked it up myself. Now on drum, I picked it up myself, but there's a fellow by the name of Floyd Casey. He came down here with no Faith Marvelous, with Faith Marvel. It was him and Floyd Casey and he was a wonderful drummer too.
That's the same guy who used to work with Dewey Jackson? Might have been.

I know he's from way around St. Louis. Yeah, well they played on St. Louis. Yeah, he had a four octave I think of Viperphone. No, he wasn't a Viperphone, remember. Yeah. And then he could play piano too. He was a wonderful drummer. Well I took some lessons for him. But see, after he, I was a fellow to advance fast. I took lessons on the clarinet too, but a fellow wanted to take me away from him because I, I used to, that sit out, you see the method to make the clarinet now, is very simplified.
